item.title: 🔴 npm Adds 2FA-Gated Publishing and Package Install Controls Against Supply Chain Attacks
item.description:
Why this matters: Supply chain risk — audit third-party dependencies and vendor access.
GitHub has rolled out new controls for npm to improve the security of the software supply chain, giving maintainers the ability to explicitly approve a release prior to the packages becoming publicly available for installation. Called staged publishing, the feature is now generally available on npm. It mandates that a human maintainer pass a two-factor authentication (2FA) challenge to approve

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1d ago

item.title: 🔵 Ghostwriter Targets Ukraine Government Entities with Prometheus Phishing Malware
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
The Belarus-aligned threat actor known as Ghostwriter (aka UAC-0057 and UNC1151) has been observed using lures related to Prometheus, a Ukrainian online learning platform, to target government organizations in the country. item.title: 🟠 Cisco Patches CVSS 10.0 Secure Workload REST API Flaw Enabling Data Access
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact sign-ins/MFA/Conditional Access — watch for login issues.

Tracked as CVE-2026-20223 (CVSS score: 10.0), the vulnerability arises from insufficient validation and authentication when accessing REST API endpoints.
